# #47071 - [AI Foundry] Simplify voice models and preserve Foundry audio contracts

## Reusable rules

1. **Reuse upstream fields only when their contract matches** When composing a Foundry model from an OpenAI model, omit only fields that need replacement or are unsupported. Avoid redeclaring fields such as `input` or `server_url` when the upstream declaration already supplies the intended contract. *Scope:* Foundry voice response, request, and MCP-tool models composed from OpenAI models *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/bd217004f5d304d365275fa4b56db16eac4ea5b5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/agents.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/bd217004f5d304d365275fa4b56db16eac4ea5b5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/bd217004f5d304d365275fa4b56db16eac4ea5b5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/protocol.tsp

2. **Keep SDK customizations aligned with model changes** When a TypeSpec model is removed or renamed, update language-specific naming and metadata mappings that refer to it; retain alternate-type mappings needed to reuse published upstream SDK types. *Scope:* C# and Java client customizations and Java emitter metadata for these Foundry voice models *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/bd217004f5d304d365275fa4b56db16eac4ea5b5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-csharp-azure-ai-projects-agents/client.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/bd217004f5d304d365275fa4b56db16eac4ea5b5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-java-azure-ai-agents/client.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/bd217004f5d304d365275fa4b56db16eac4ea5b5/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-java-azure-ai-agents/tspconfig.yaml
